title: Executive Assistant
description:
**Role Summary:**

We're looking for a smart, fast, and trustworthy **Executive Assistant** who can work directly with the Managing Director to **take complete ownership of day\-to\-day execution**. If you're someone who thrives in chaos, brings order to moving parts, and loves making things run smoothly—you’ll fit right in.

This is not a personal secretary job. This is a **mission\-critical support role** designed to keep the founder focused on growth, while you handle coordination, follow\-ups, communication, and operational fire\-fighting.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Executive Support: \-** Manage MD's calendar (reminders as well), emails, and communications and coordinate with team across all businesses. Host daily 15\-minute check\-ins and track performance.
* **Vendor \& External Relations:** Be the MD's go\-to person for operational updates and queries. Liaise with vendors, bankers, and external partners
* **Task \& Project Management:** \- Manage projects, track progress, and ensure timely completion using tools like e.g., Notion, Trello.
* **Team Performance \& Reporting:** \- Ensure data accuracy and prepare reports. Collect daily reports from team members and work with HR to crunch the numbers. Help identify areas where they can improve and suggest ways to make things more efficient.
* **Personal Assistance: \-** Provide personal assistance to MD, including appointments and logistics. Help out with personal errands and requests as needed.
* **Data Management \& Admin:** Keep records and files up\-to\-date and accurate. Prep reports and presentations as needed

**Must\-Have Skills \& Qualities**

* **Ownership mindset:** You don’t wait to be told what to do. You chase clarity and get things done.
* **Strong follow\-up game:** You know how to get responses without nagging.
* **Fast and sharp:** You learn tools and systems quickly.
* **Clear communicator:** Whether it’s WhatsApp or email, your language is crisp and professional.
* **Fluent in English and Tamil/Hindi**
* **Tech\-savvy:** Comfortable using Google Workspace, Excel, WhatsApp Business, courier portals, and task trackers.

**Eligibility**

* 1–3 years of experience as an EA, project coordinator, or operations assistant
* Chennai\-based and ready to work **on\-site** full\-time

**What You’ll Get**

* Direct exposure to how to manage and scale up multiple ventures and managing multiple business functions of completely different types of ventures.
* Chance to work **directly with the MD of multiple companies.**
* Opportunities to see the Ventures/Brands creations from the scratch and scaling up.
* Opportunity to grow into a senior operations or management role based on performance
* Fast\-paced, clarity\-driven work environment.

Pay: ₹23,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Manager HRBP
description:
Posted date Sep. 17, 2026
Contract type Full time
Job ID R\-260111
  
**Why choose AstraZeneca India?**
---------------------------------


Help push the boundaries of science to deliver life\-changing medicines to patients. After 45 years in India, we’re continuing to secure a future where everyone can access affordable, sustainable, innovative healthcare.


The part you play in our business will be challenging, yet rewarding, requiring you to use your resilient, collaborative and diplomatic skillsets to make connections. The majority of your work will be field based, and will require you to be highly\-organised, planning your monthly schedule, attending meetings and calls, as well as writing up reports.


**Who do we look for?**
-----------------------


Calling all tech innovators, ownership takers, challenge seekers and proactive collaborators. At AstraZeneca, breakthroughs born in the lab become transformative medicine for the world's most complex diseases. We empower people like you to push the boundaries of science, challenge convention, and unleash your entrepreneurial spirit. You'll embrace differences and take bold actions to drive the change needed to meet global healthcare and sustainability challenges.


Here, diverse minds and bold disruptors can meaningfully impact the future of healthcare using cutting\-edge technology. Whether you join us in Bengaluru or Chennai, you can make a tangible impact within a global biopharmaceutical company that invests in your future. Join a talented global team that's powering AstraZeneca to better serve patients every day.


**Success Profile**
-------------------


Ready to make an impact in your career? If you're passionate, growth\-orientated and a true team player, we'll help you succeed. Here are some of the skills and capabilities we look for.


### **Tech innovators**


Make a greater impact through our digitally enabled enterprise. Use your skills in data and technology to transform and optimise our operations, helping us deliver meaningful work that changes lives.


### **Ownership takers**


If you're a self\-aware self\-starter who craves autonomy, AstraZeneca provides the perfect environment to take ownership and grow. Here, you'll feel empowered to lead and reach excellence at every level — with unrivalled support when you need it.


### **Challenge seekers**


Adapting and advancing our progress means constantly challenging the status quo. In this dynamic environment where everything we do has urgency and focus, you'll have the ability to show up, speak up and confidently take smart risks.


### **Proactive collaborators**


Your unique perspectives make our ambitions and capabilities possible. Our culture of sharing ideas, learning and improving together helps us consistently set the bar higher. As a proactive collaborator, you'll seek out ways to bring people together to achieve their best.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------


**Job ID** R\-260111 **Date posted** 09/17/2026
**Job Title: Senior Manager HRBP**


**GCL:E**


**Introduction to role:**


At AstraZeneca we are guided in our work by a strong set of values, and we’re resetting expectations of what a biopharmaceutical company can be. By truly following the science, we pioneer new methods, new thinking and bring unexpected teams together. From scientists to sales, lab techs to legal, we’re on a mission to turn ideas into life changing medicines that transform lives. We need great people who share our passion for science and have the drive and determination to meet the unmet needs of patients around the world. If you’re swift to action, confident to lead, willing to collaborate, and curious about what science can do, then you’re our kind of person.


Are you ready to transform people strategies into measurable business outcomes that accelerate the delivery of life\-changing medicines? This role partners directly with senior leaders to shape workforce plans, elevate performance, and build a culture where bold ideas turn into real\-world impact for patients.


**Accountabilities:**


* Contribute to and supports the execution of the business area’s strategic direction and HR agenda.
* Lead multidisciplinary HR projects across recruitment, compensation, benefits, performance, people, employee relations, and change.
* Liaise with senior management to define business needs and tailor HR and employee relations solutions.
* Act as the main point of contact for complex HR policy issues, advice, and guidance.
* Guide, mentors, and challenges manager on the application of HR and employee relations practices.
* Ensure HR interventions are integrated, consistent, and aligned with organizational objectives.
* Drive and supports the development and implementation of cultural and organizational change plans.
* Ensure compliance with corporate policies, collective agreements, and local employment laws.
* Monitor employee relations trends and resolves ER issues, managing risk and liaising with appropriate experts as needed.
* Review and analyze business unit data to identify trends and recommend solutions to improve performance, retention, and employee experience
* Plan, manage and provide continuous improvement to all aspects of the client organization and leadership review process and the strategic objectives therein. This includes both annual and any adhoc increases which focus on performance management and talent development.
* Nurture Performance Driven Culture \- Consult and Coach Managers on understanding AZ Performance Framework, Driving Performance Discussions and Addressing Underperformance.
* Lead Pulse Survey \& Culture transformation agenda – Ensuring employee participation, Focus Group discussion with employees on Pulse Insights, Action Planning with Leadership basis FGDs and Pulse insights, Handholding Leaders in driving action plan implementation and progress.
* Plan and steer employee engagement initiatives to promote synergies and spirit of camaraderie amongst employees (Employee Connect, Leadership, People Manager Connect).

**Essential Skills/Experience:**


* 10\+ Years post qualification HR experience with minimum 6 years in Business partnering
* Postgraduate Degree/MBA in HR from Institute of repute.
* Excellent business insight and the ability to think and act strategically in the deployment of HR interventions
* Ability to design and deliver HR solutions in line with business priorities
* Ability to build \& forge strong relationships with collaborators and the ability to influence change
* Should continually look for opportunity areas \& challenge the status quo to enhance efficiency \& effectiveness
* Excellent communication skills, detailed oriented \& organized
* Demonstrate AZ values consistently
* AI and Digital HR Proficiency

**Desirable Skills/Experience:**


* Experience partnering within IT/ITES and global matrix environments.
* Shown delivery of large\-scale organizational change using design thinking and agile methodologies.
* Sophisticated proficiency with HR analytics platforms and visualization tools.
* Depth in employee relations across multiple jurisdictions and compensation planning.
* Coaching credentials or certifications in organisational change, ER, or OD.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life\-changing medicines. In\-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and bold world.


**Why AstraZeneca:**


Join a distributed team that fuels the enterprise with insight, innovation, and courage. Unexpected teams share the same space, fueling bold thinking that directly improves how we serve patients. We blend mission with momentum, using digital innovation and data\-driven decisions to simplify, modernize, and scale smarter ways of working. Here, entrepreneurial spirit is real: you’ll own ideas, make quick, ethical decisions, and see your work ripple across the organization. We value courtesy alongside ambition and provide the support, networks, and autonomy you need to stretch, grow, and build an unrivalled reputation while making a relevant difference.


Bring your bold HR leadership to AstraZeneca and turn ambition into impact—step forward today to shape a high\-performing, patient\-focused future!

We're driven by our shared values of serving people, society and the planet. Our people make this possible, which is why we prioritise diversity, safety, empowerment and collaboration. Discover what a career at AstraZeneca could mean for you.

Our development opportunities are second to none. You'll have the chance to grow your abilities, skills and knowledge constantly as you accelerate your career. From leadership projects and constructive coaching to overseas talent exchanges and global collaboration programmes, you'll never stand still.

title: Corporate Relations Manager
description:
Corporate Relations Manager

**Company:** NxtWave  
**Job Title:** Corporate Relations Manager  
**Location:** Delhi / Pune / Chennai  
**Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Experience:** 1–7 Years  
**Work Schedule:** 6 Days a Week (1st \& 3rd Saturday Off)  
**Role Type:** Individual Contributor

Job Summary

NxtWave is looking for a **Corporate Relations Manager** to build and manage corporate relationships and drive hiring partnerships with companies.

This is a **target\-driven B2B sales and corporate relations role** where you will independently identify companies, generate leads, connect with decision\-makers, understand hiring requirements, manage the complete engagement process, and convert companies into long\-term partners.

The ideal candidate should have experience in **B2B Sales, Corporate Hiring, Recruitment, Staffing, EdTech Partnerships, or Placement Services** and should be comfortable with cold calling, LinkedIn outreach, client meetings, follow\-ups, and achieving targets.

Key ResponsibilitiesCorporate Acquisition \& Business Development

* Identify and target companies with current or potential hiring requirements.
* Generate leads independently through LinkedIn, job portals, company websites, databases, and other channels.
* Conduct cold calls, emails, WhatsApp and LinkedIn outreach.
* Connect with Founders, CEOs, CTOs, CHROs, HR Heads, and Talent Acquisition teams.
* Understand company hiring needs, skill requirements, timelines, and business challenges.
* Present NxtWave's hiring and talent solutions based on company requirements.
* Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of prospective companies.
* Re\-engage previous or inactive companies to identify new opportunities.

Requirement Management \& Closure

* Understand and document client requirements including roles, skills, headcount, location, compensation, and timelines.
* Coordinate with internal sourcing and candidate profiling teams.
* Share suitable candidate profiles with clients.
* Follow up with clients for feedback and interview updates.
* Coordinate interviews, hiring drives, and candidate communication.
* Track interview results, selections, offers, and joining status.
* Drive requirements from initial discussion to successful closure.

Client Relationship Management

* Act as the primary point of contact for corporate clients.
* Build strong and long\-term relationships with companies.
* Convert one\-time requirements into repeat hiring opportunities.
* Identify opportunities for multiple roles and long\-term partnerships.
* Conduct client meetings, video calls, company visits, and industry networking activities.
* Collect client feedback, testimonials, and success stories.
* Maintain regular communication with key decision\-makers.

CRM \& Reporting

* Maintain accurate records of all companies, leads, opportunities, and follow\-ups.
* Update CRM status and next\-action dates after every interaction.
* Track calls, emails, meetings, requirements, interviews, and closures.
* Maintain a healthy sales pipeline with no missed follow\-ups.
* Participate in daily stand\-ups and weekly performance reviews.
* Track performance against weekly and monthly targets.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be measured based on:

* Number of companies onboarded with active requirements.
* Corporate meetings and engagements generated.
* Requirements received from companies.
* Interviews and hiring drives conducted.
* Candidate selections and closures.
* Conversion from requirement to interview and interview to selection.
* Repeat business from existing companies.
* Pipeline and CRM management.
* Follow\-up and relationship management.

Required Qualifications \& Experience

* Graduate in any discipline.
* MBA is preferred but not mandatory.
* **1–7 years of experience** in any of the following:
* B2B Sales
* Corporate Sales
* Business Development
* Corporate Recruitment
* Staffing / Recruitment
* EdTech Partnerships
* Placement Services
* Client Relationship Management
* Must have experience in independently generating leads and managing a B2B sales cycle.
* Experience in prospecting, client communication, negotiation, and closing is preferred.
* Candidates should be comfortable with targets and high\-volume outreach.

Required Skills

* B2B Sales \& Business Development
* Corporate Relationship Management
* Lead Generation \& Prospecting
* Cold Calling
* LinkedIn Outreach
* Client Acquisition
* Negotiation \& Closing
* Requirement Gathering
* Follow\-up \& Pipeline Management
* CRM Management
* Excellent verbal and written communication
* Relationship Building
* Target\-oriented approach

Preferred Tools

Experience with tools such as:

* HubSpot
* Salesforce
* Pipedrive
* LinkedIn Sales Navigator
* Apollo
* RocketReach
* Other CRM and lead\-generation platforms

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate:

* Has a strong **hunter mindset** and can generate their own leads.
* Is comfortable making high\-volume calls and conducting outreach.
* Can independently manage multiple corporate relationships.
* Understands B2B sales and client acquisition.
* Can handle rejection and maintain consistent follow\-ups.
* Is target\-driven and focused on measurable results.
* Has strong communication and negotiation skills.
* Can build long\-term relationships with corporate decision\-makers.
* Is comfortable working in a fast\-paced and target\-oriented environment.

Important Note

This role requires **independent B2B lead generation and client acquisition experience**.

Candidates whose experience is limited to **campus placements, internship\-only sales/recruitment, warm leads, or pre\-assigned accounts** may not be suitable for this position.

title: SAP HCM lead consultant
description:
Founded in 1976, CGI is among the world's largest independent IT and business consulting services firms. With 94,000 consultants and professionals globally, CGI delivers an end\-to\-end portfolio of capabilities, from strategic IT and business consulting to systems integration, managed IT and business process services, and intellectual property solutions. CGI works with clients through a local relationship model complemented by a global delivery network that helps clients digitally transform their organizations and accelerate results. CGI Fiscal 2024 reported revenue is CA$14\.68 billion, and CGI shares are listed on the TSX (GIB.A) and the NYSE (GIB). Learn more about us at cgi.com.  

  

Job Title: SAP HCM lead consultant  

Experience: 10\+ Years  

Job Location: Bangalore / Chennai / Hyderabad / Pune / Mumbai  

Position ID: J0926\-0309  

Work Type: Hybrid  

Employment Type: Full Time / Permanent  

Qualification: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.  

  

We are seeking an experienced SAP HCM Lead Consultant with 10\+ years of domain expertise to drive the design, implementation, governance, and support of our Human Capital Management landscape for project.  

  

In this role, you will act as the principal solution architect and team lead, bridging business requirements with SAP technical capabilities. You will bring rich SAP HCM Functional Knowledge to design end to end HR processes, build critical interfaces (especially Time \& Attendance), lead custom report development, and guide our S/4HANA implementation. The ideal candidate will serve as the strategic bridge between HR business stakeholders and IT technical teams, overseeing end to end module configuration, cross system integrations, data flows, and team leadership.  

  

Key Responsibilities
  

  

1\. End\-to\-End HCM Functional Ownership  

* Provide deep functional expertise across all primary SAP HCM processes (PA OM Time Management \& Payroll) evaluating HR business models and translating business requirements into optimal SAP functional designs.
